global_prerequisites: Root/user authorizes the specific activity and budget; this file grants neither.
Reviewer freezes exact specimen BOM, drawing revision and test acceptance limits before testing.
Qualified operator approves hazards, facility, instruments, calibration and emergency response.
Each test records raw measurements, units, uncertainty, calibration IDs, deviations and specimen serials.

tests.title: Incoming part and dimension inspection
tests.method: Measure purchased part datums, mounts, protrusions, cable exits and mass; compare against exact vendor drawings and CAD assumptions.
tests.acceptance_rule: Every mating feature fits its approved tolerance and CAD allocation; vendor/provisional discrepancies cause a revision, not forced assembly.

tests.title: Dry fit, tool access and cable service
tests.method: Assemble inert parts and dummy instruments; check fastener access, removable tray travel, lid sweep, connector mating, strain-relief grip and bend radius at service extremes.
equipment: Torque tools after torque specification freeze
freeze_before_test: Exact cable/connector diameters and minimum bend radius
tests.acceptance_rule: Approved clearances and bend-radius limits hold at worst-case tolerances and service positions; no printed part carries a primary mooring or pressure load.

tests.title: Purchased pressure boundary and leak qualification
tests.owner: Qualified pressure-test facility and mechanical reviewer
tests.method: Facility develops a guarded procedure for the exact purchased housing, endcaps, optical window, seals and penetrators; measure leakage and inspect before/after approved pressure and immersion cycles.
equipment: Traceably calibrated pressure and temperature instruments
Leak detection method approved by facility
freeze_before_test: Operating depth, duration, cycles and temperature
Test medium and approved test pressure
tests.acceptance_rule: Exact configuration passes the facility-approved protocol with traceable raw data; neither an IP code nor a CAD model substitutes for this test.
tests.safety_note: The CAD pressure-test fixture is only a positioning cradle. It is not pressure containment, a pressure source, a safety guard or an instruction to overpressure equipment.

tests.title: Loads, retention, buoyancy and retrieval
tests.owner: Marine mechanical engineer with farm operator
tests.method: Calculate then verify configured mass/CG and buoyancy; apply approved static/cyclic loads to representative attachments and restraints; rehearse recovery using inert equipment in an authorized setting.
tests.acceptance_rule: Approved load cases retain equipment without slip, damage or blocked recovery; cables and printed instrument supports are not substituted for the designed primary restraint.

tests.title: Corrosion, fouling and environmental exposure
tests.method: Test representative mixed-material joints, coatings, isolation washers, cables and seals under an approved marine exposure protocol; inspect fouling and galvanic/crevice corrosion at scheduled intervals.
tests.acceptance_rule: Material and isolation system passes approved limits without loss of retention, sealing or service access; a generic stainless or printed polymer label is insufficient.

tests.title: Electrical inspection, fuse and isolation review
tests.method: Inspect against released wiring; verify polarity, continuity, protective bonding/isolation intent, fuse/wire/connector coordination, insulation and backfeed paths before energization.
equipment: Current-limited isolated bench source after authorization
Appropriate insulation test equipment only under approved procedure
freeze_before_test: Exact conductor insulation/gauge and ampacity conditions
tests.acceptance_rule: Approved continuity/isolation tests pass and faults are cleared within coordinated conductor/component limits. Numeric fuse placeholders cannot pass this gate.

tests.title: Power states, inrush and brownout
tests.method: Measure steady, burst and startup loads at battery extrema with the exact USB-C source, DAQ, storage, radio and camera; apply approved supply ramps and interruption cases; record reset and data-recovery behavior.
freeze_before_test: Rail operating limits at each load
USB-C current advertisement and backfeed checks
tests.acceptance_rule: Measured rails stay inside selected component limits for every approved state; protection trips safely, no unintended power path bypasses cutoff, and recovery does not arm output.

tests.title: Thermal and solar reserve
tests.method: Instrument the closed representative enclosures and selected battery under approved ambient/solar/load conditions; measure heat paths, charging limits and energy over representative worst-season profiles.
equipment: Site irradiance record or explicitly simulated bench profile
freeze_before_test: Component derating and battery temperature limits
tests.acceptance_rule: Measured temperatures and charging remain within selected part limits and required reserve holds under the approved profile. Assumed peak-sun-hours and lumped thermal resistance are not field evidence.

tests.title: Receive calibration and synchronization
tests.owner: Underwater acoustics specialist with acquisition lead
tests.method: Calibrate the selected hydrophone/DAQ gain and frequency response using traceable reference equipment; measure channel delay, clock drift and camera time alignment. Record uncertainty and full-chain serials.
equipment: Electrical signal source after test authorization
freeze_before_test: Selected acquisition band and sample rate
Array geometry and clock topology if enabled
tests.acceptance_rule: Measured gain/frequency/time response meets preregistered measurement requirements; digital RMS/peak is not reported as underwater SPL without this chain and its uncertainty.

tests.title: Optional wiper guard, jam and optical endurance
tests.method: Use an authorized guarded bench setup for the selected drive and window; verify stop travel, current/time limits, jam response, scratch risk, image obstruction and service replacement over an approved cycle count.
tests.acceptance_rule: Drive stops independently within approved mechanical/electrical bounds, does not damage the window and restores required visibility. CAD swept volume alone cannot pass this test.

tests.title: Optional output physical stop and fault injection, dummy load only
tests.method: After separate authorization and released design, test the hardware inhibit against CPU halt, stuck commands, lost heartbeat, brownout, stop-loop opening/short faults and welded-contact/shorted-driver cases with inert dummy loads only.
equipment: Physical stop and independent watchdog circuit
freeze_before_test: Exact power stage and disconnect design
Maximum residual energy and stop latency
tests.acceptance_rule: Every approved fault reaches independently bounded output or electrical silence within approved bounds; reset never rearms automatically. Software state reports do not prove power removal.

tests.title: Optional calibrated acoustic output and ecological gate
tests.method: Only after written permissions and PV-11, calibrate the exact projector/amplifier chain at an authorized facility under the approved exposure protocol; biological efficacy remains a separate controlled study.
tests.acceptance_rule: Independent reviewers accept the calibrated chain and approved safety/exposure evidence. No universal acoustic safe level, species response or prevention efficacy is inferred from electrical tests.

tests.title: Above-water communications and EMC
tests.method: Verify the exact regional radio/antenna/gateway configuration, airtime and installation against the approved radio plan; test co-located DC converters, receive chain, camera and radio for interference in authorized facilities.
tests.acceptance_rule: Approved above-water link and interference limits pass for the complete assembly. Purchased module markings are not whole-system conformity evidence.

tests.title: Independent assembly and service reproduction
tests.method: Build a serial-tracked reference unit from the released package without undocumented designer intervention; log missing instructions, rework, actual consumed parts, inspection and recovery/service trials.
tests.acceptance_rule: Reviewer resolves every undocumented step and failed inspection before any production claim; actual yield, labor and cost come from records, not this plan.
